The '''Moenia University''' was a [[University/Legends|university]] located in the city of [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]], on the world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:MU" /> The [[Classical Naboo style/Legends|Naboo-styled]] university building was built in front of an ancient ruined [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] structure nicknamed '''Moenia University Hall'''.<ref name="SWG:RaSPotsGA" />

==History==
[[File:Moenia_University_Hall.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Moenia University Hall]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], several individuals such as the scholar [[Ronin Lightrunner]]<ref name="SWG:RL">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Ronin Lightrunner|Naboo}}</ref> and [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial Officer]] [[Jaek Vercet]] visited the university.<ref name="SWG:BIttER">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=faction|Imperial|Bring Information to the Emperor's Retreat|Naboo}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer sent by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] visited the Moenia University Hall to retrieve one of the pieces of a broken Gungan artifact scattered by the [[Ultragungans]] in various areas of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:RaSPotsGA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Moenia University was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
